annotations.title: Car costs in Poland: cost of 100 km and of a trip, taxes when buying or importing a car, toll motorways, speeding fines

description: Use for the cost of driving a car in Poland: cost of 100 km or of a trip with petrol, diesel, LPG or an electric car, taxes when buying a used car or importing a car (PCC, customs duty, excise, import VAT), toll motorways and speeding fines. For maximum fuel prices only, use get_fuel_prices; for charging prices by network, use get_ev_charging_prices. Daily cost of driving 100 km in Poland (finwire_car_cost_100km) with petrol 95, diesel, LPG and electricity (home G12 tariff, public AC and DC chargers) for an average compact car (ICCT real-world consumption), with the prices of the day and their sources. Optional distance_km gives the cost of a trip for the chosen energy, consumption and persons. Also the legal constants of buying a car: PCC on a used car from a private person (rate, exemption threshold), customs duty for cars from outside the EU (third-country duty, 0% for cars originating in the USA since the EU regulation), import VAT and the order duty, excise, VAT; toll motorway sections free or paid for cars up to 3.5 t with announced changes; speeding fines and penalty points. No amounts for concession tolls.

consumption.description: Consumption per 100 km (litres, or kWh for ev_*); default the reference car.

distance_km.description: Trip distance in km for the trip cost.

energy.description: Fuel or charging for the trip cost, default petrol95.

persons.description: Persons sharing the trip cost, default 1.

round_trip.description: Count the way back too, default false.
